provider: Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (GDACS) – European Commission JRC / UN OCHA
dataset: GDACS disaster alerts (RSS feed of current events and event-list API)
description: Automatic multi-hazard disaster alerts with an estimated humanitarian impact level (Green/Orange/Red) for tropical cyclones, floods, droughts, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions and forest fires, including population-exposure estimates and alert scores.

coverage.temporal: Events GDACS currently lists in its main feed (roughly the past week, longer for droughts) plus cyclone, flood, volcano and drought events that were active in the past 14 days.

updateCadence.upstream: Feeds are regenerated about every 6 minutes

attribution: GDACS – Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System, © European Union (CC BY 4.0)

license.name: European Union copyright notice in the GDACS feeds: CC BY 4.0, reuse allowed with credit to GDACS
license.notes: Every item of the RSS feed carries "Copyright notice: European Union (CC BY 4.0), reuse is allowed, provided appropriate credit to GDACS is given." (the channel element itself says "public domain"). The GDACS terms-of-use page states no licence; it is a disclaimer: information is provided as is, alerts are automatic and must not be used for decision making without confirmation from official sources.

limitations: Alerts for earthquakes, tsunamis and tropical cyclones are produced automatically by models and are not reviewed by experts before publication; impact estimates carry large uncertainties.
The alert level estimates the likely need for international humanitarian assistance, not the physical size of the event; GDACS does not replace official national warnings.
Each event is shown at a single centroid point; cyclone tracks, flood extents and drought areas are not included.
The main feed lists only the earthquakes GDACS currently notifies (a small subset of all earthquakes); population exposure is available only for events present in that feed.
The 'current' flag is taken from GDACS as is and is occasionally inconsistent with the event text (e.g. long droughts).
confidenceNotes: GDACS publishes no confidence value, so records carry none; the 'temporary' flag of preliminary events is kept as an attribute. Severity is derived by this application from the GDACS alert colour of the event: Green → minor (1), Orange → severe (3), Red → extreme (4); the colour itself is kept as the severity label.

retention.note: Events are kept for 30 days after they ended or were last listed as current (droughts: 90 days).

layers.name: Tropical cyclone alerts (GDACS)
layers.description: Tropical cyclones with the GDACS humanitarian impact alert level, maximum wind speed and exposed population.

layers.name: Flood alerts (GDACS)
layers.description: Flood events detected by GDACS/GLOFAS with their alert level and affected-population estimate.

layers.name: Drought alerts (GDACS)
layers.description: Agricultural drought events from the Global Drought Observatory with GDACS alert level and affected area.

layers.name: Earthquake impact alerts (GDACS)
layers.description: Earthquakes notified by GDACS with the estimated humanitarian impact level and population exposed to shaking.

layers.name: Volcanic eruption alerts (GDACS)
layers.description: Volcanic eruptions registered by GDACS (from volcanic ash advisories) with their alert level.

layers.name: Forest fire alerts (GDACS)
layers.description: Large forest fires detected by GDACS/GWIS with alert level and burned area.
